summary.intent: Fix a duplicate CI/release workflow run in callisto by serializing the release workflow's concurrency, then open a PR for the change.
summary.outcome: Changed the workflow's concurrency group to a single shared `release` group, updated the comment and docs/releasing.md, and opened PR #403. Local `just workflow-contracts` passed; CI on the PR has not been observed and the change is not tested live.

repo: The callisto repo has a `just workflow-contracts` recipe that validates workflow files and exits 0 when they pass.
The release workflow previously used a per-commit concurrency group, so pushes during a release could start a duplicate run.
docs/releasing.md documents release behavior and should be updated when workflow concurrency semantics change.
PR bodies in this repo should not include a session link (a user rule).
NEXT-WORK.md lives in a shared checkout and is refreshed separately; its first item (the duplicate run) is now addressed by #403.

code.finding: Concurrency group changed from one per pushed commit to a single `release` group so pushes queue behind an in-progress release and then find nothing pending. The comment was updated to match. No specific line numbers were referenced in the transcript.

workflow: Write the PR body to a temp file (e.g. under ~/.claude/jobs/.../tmp) and use it when opening the PR.
Report plainly what was verified locally versus what remains unverified (CI run, live release-time push test).

friction: A single shared concurrency group has an edge case: an explicit-SHA dispatch queued behind a push can be replaced, so users must dispatch it again.
The refreshed NEXT-WORK.md still has to be manually copied into the shared checkout.
open_items: Watch the CI run on PR #403 once it starts.
Live-test by pushing during a release to confirm it queues and then only refreshes the release PR.
Copy the refreshed NEXT-WORK.md into the shared checkout.
Consider whether the explicit-SHA dispatch replacement edge case needs a better fix than the documented re-dispatch workaround.
